Select chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules in document CHEMBL1145073. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce availability of canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1145073'. Return distinct rows. Order by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
